name: Press moulding in a bowl mould
summary: Soft clay is pressed into a fired clay mould that carries a design in reverse. The bowl keeps a sharp relief when it comes out of the mould.
how: Stamp or carve the design into a bowl-shaped mould of clay.
Press soft clay into the mould and let it dry a little.
Lift out the bowl, then turn the rim and the foot on the wheel.

origin.note: Potters of Athens make relief bowls in moulds, now called Megarian bowls.

adoptions.via: The workshops of Arretium press stamped bowls in fired moulds and coat them with a red slip.
